title: The Lantern Festival
task: Sela wants to light the ceremonial lantern at the Lantern Festival. Based only on the supplied document, tell Sela what to do, in order. Recommend one valid course of action rather than listing alternatives. Give exactly three numbered steps.
setting: Every autumn, the hill village of Namar lights one ceremonial lantern at the beginning of its festival. Two lighting customs are preserved in the village book. Each one produces a proper festival flame. The keeper asks a person to select one custom and complete its three steps, since combining the supplies and arches creates confusion for the assistants.
history: The older custom uses a cedar taper carried from the carpenter's bench. The lighter places it in the bronze brazier and then walks to the western arch, where the flame is raised. The bronze brazier is broad and familiar, and the elders say this custom reflects the village's first festival. It is valid every year, even when the newer custom is chosen by more visitors.
new_history: The newer custom uses a wax wick prepared by the candle maker. The lighter places it in the glass flame-holder and then walks to the eastern arch, where the lantern is raised. The glass holder was introduced by the festival guild. Its custom is equally valid, and the guild welcomes people who prefer its careful preparation.

steps.text: Place it in the bronze brazier.
Carry the flame to the western arch.
Place it in the glass flame-holder.
Carry the flame to the eastern arch.
